# SplitMix64Rng

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Generation` in assembly `Nfty.Ticket`.

```csharp
public sealed class SplitMix64Rng : IRng
```

SplitMix64. Small, fast, and — the reason it is here — fully specified, so the same seed yields the same sequence on every platform and runtime.
